title: AgenticDex
tagline: AgenticDex is a next-generation decentralized exchange (DEX) powered by AI-driven chat agents, redefining the trading experience with intelligent assistance and seamless automation.
description:
AgenticDex is an evolving decentralized exchange (DEX) that brings AI-driven automation to the world of crypto trading.

Currently, the platform enables users to seamlessly swap tokens on the Base chain, leveraging Moralis for fetching prices in USD of the tokens and 1inch API for fetching exchange rates and executing swaps.

Beyond simple token swaps, AgenticDex is expanding its functionality to allow users to select their preferred liquidity pools across various DEXs like Uniswap (feature in development).

A key innovation of AgenticDex is its AI-powered assistant, designed to simplify trading with just a prompt. This agent, built using Coinbase Developer Platform’s Agent Kit and integrated with Gaia’s Llama 8B model (https://llama8b.gaia.domains/v1), currently supports basic wallet queries such as retrieving wallet addresses and balances, with ongoing work to expand its capabilities.

For liquidity providers, the platform features a simulated liquidity pool deployed on the Base Sepolia testnet, allowing users to test the Pool Assistant, powered by Hugging Face’s AI interface. The pool supports two hypothetical ERC-20 tokens, CLK and MIR, and enables users to:
✅ Approve the contract to manage their tokens
✅ Swap tokens
✅ Provide and remove liquidity

If clicking buttons isn’t your style, the Pool Assistant in the chat section allows you to perform all these actions through natural language commands.

With AI-driven automation and decentralized trading at its core, AgenticDex is shaping the future of DeFi. 🚀
how_its_made:
AgenticDex is built on cutting-edge technologies that power its decentralized trading and AI-driven automation. Here’s how each component contributes to the project:

Moralis API – providing the token prices in USD.
1inch API – Aggregates exchange rates from multiple DEXs, ensuring the best possible swap prices and executing trades efficiently.
Coinbase Developer Platform’s Agent Kit – Powers the AI assistant, allowing users to interact with the DEX through simple prompts for tasks like checking wallet balances.
Gaia – Integrates advanced AI models (Llama 8B) to enhance the assistant’s capabilities, enabling intelligent trade execution and decision-making.
Hugging Face – Supports the Pool Assistant, facilitating natural language interactions for liquidity management, token swaps, and other DeFi actions.
Being completely new to all these technologies, the past 1.5 weeks have been an incredible learning journey for me. Experimenting with AI, in particular, has been a standout experience, marking my first deep dive into AI-driven development. Playing around with AI assistants and integrating them into a real-world DeFi project has been both challenging and rewarding, significantly accelerating my growth as a developer.

With AgenticDex, I’m not just building a decentralized exchange—I'm exploring the potential of AI in DeFi and pushing myself to innovate in ways I never imagined before. 🚀
